sourceBook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

discoveries.sourceDerivedIssue: Phase1 statblock page 95 is an introduction; actual printed CL9 block begins p96. Preserve unchanged Phase1 identity/locator until independent page-map reconciliation.
Hyperdrive x2 uses 10-jump utility-droid memory; no full utility-droid station skills stated.
Eight proton torpedoes accompany a pilot-controlled alternative weapon group.
10-jump memory utility droid is printed; independent crew contribution is not quantified.
Narrative reports missing motivators/inertial dampeners on defective factory units; stock published x3 hyperdrive should not be overwritten.
No SR line; unknown/unstated is not zero or proven unshielded.
Pilot +2 equipment bonus explicitly only if untrained in Pilot.
Escape configuration modifies existing statblock on p99, including SR, capacity and hyperdrive; not an independent Phase1 identity.
The base p98 statblock has no hyperdrive field; the p99 escape variation includes x2 and x10 backup.
Gunner lasers and pilot missiles use separate attacks; light concussion missiles have printed payload 12.
Crew5 expert stock; narrative says operable effectively with pilot and one other; requires operational crew stations and capacity logic.
Two cockpits/two gunner pods and 2+2 printed cannons; spare mounting point count/arcs unspecified.
+5 equipment only to Mechanics checks to install weapon systems, not global Mechanics.
No hyperdrive entry printed; do not infer a speed multiplier.
No statted weapons despite narrative minor defensive systems; weapon list empty due to absent printed attacks, not proof of no hardware.
Passengers 10 standard configuration; carried craft varies by mission.
Forgo attacks as standard action for 2-square-radius allied +1 Reflex and +10 Fortitude AND damage threshold.
Three weapon group types each show 2 batteries; detailed gunners 4,3,3; physical mounts within each battery unspecified.
Tractor batteries printed attack +11, size target variant -9 and grapple +63; requires non-damage resolution.
-20 penalty on turret/tractor attacks against target smaller than Colossal is printed.
Section title Jedi Covenant Shuttle; actual CL6 statblock is Baronial-class Yacht.
Narrative indicates models vary, but gives no second full statblock.
Standard action forgo all attacks; enemy starships in 2-square area -1 Reflex and -2 speed min1.
Four projectors, +8 3x3 starship area, damage Special (SG45); SG45 effect must be resolved from source authority before automation.
5/6/3 battery group counts and 4 gravity projectors explicitly printed but firing arcs and constituent mounts not.
Tractor beam attacks +10 (-10 vs targets smaller than Colossal), non-damage grapple +61.
-20 against smaller-than-Colossal applies on asterisked medium turbolaser and tractor attacks.
